segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hello, this is Brian from the insurance office on Third Street. I'm calling about your homeowner's policy.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Yes, speaking.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: How was the birthday party?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Loud. Eleven little ones and a piñata. I was in bed by eight.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The renewal is six hundred dollars for the year. I found a discount for the new roof that brings it down a bit.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I'd rather keep the collision. I hit a deer once.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: The mail carrier just came. Hold on. Alright, it's just the flyer from the grocery store.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No rush.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Completely understand. We'll leave it as is.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Mail it, I'll look with my son.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Will do. Nothing to sign or pay today, the renewal just goes through automatically like before.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Okay, thank you.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: How's Harold's brother doing after the surgery?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Home now. Grumpy as ever, so he must be fine.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Have you heard from your son lately?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: He calls Sundays. He's in Denver now, with the airline.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Is the cat still bossing you around?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Every morning at five. Like clockwork.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Is your knee any better?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Some days. The doctor wants to do the injection again in the spring.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Are you going to the senior center lunch this week?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Wednesday is meatloaf, so yes.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Are you still doing the water aerobics?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Tuesdays and Thursdays. My friend Marge drives.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Did you get the pictures I sent?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I did. The baby has your father's ears, poor thing.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Did your daughter make it up for the holiday?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: She did, with the kids. The house was a zoo.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: How are you holding up with this heat?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Oh, I keep the fan on and don't go out until evening.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Did you watch the game last night?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I fell asleep in the third quarter. Did they win?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Did the furnace get fixed?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: The young man came out Tuesday. It was a sensor, thirty dollars.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: How's the garden this year?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: The tomatoes are late but the beans went crazy.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Did you get any of that rain last night?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Just a little. The gutters are still holding.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Talk to you next week.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Goodbye.
